svg.text: Stage 2 · MeanFlowPrecond uθ — average-velocity residual head (trainable)
SongUNet backbone · 14 ch in → 4 ch out · 81,040,772 params · 55 UNetBlocks · grid 192×96 · uθ(z_r, r, t, c) ≈ mean velocity over [r, t] in standardized residual space
train: (1−r)·x₀ + r·x₁ · infer: z₀ ~ N(0, I)
I (2) lsm, orog · no background S_t
in0: UNetBlock 256→256 + single-head self-attn (72 tokens) ⚡ 1.58 M
SongUNet bottleneck · 12×6 · the only attention in the network (attn_resolutions=[] disables the rest)
average velocity · r = t ⇒ FlowCast field
→ shift-only FiLM: affine Linear(512→C) of all 55 UNetBlocks
Same SongUNet backbone as the FlowCast / EDM heads —
only the objective and time embedding differ.

UNetBlock (DDPM++ residual block, adaptive_scale=False): x → GroupNorm(32, ε 1e-6) + SiLU → Conv 3×3 → ⊕ emb-shift → GroupNorm + SiLU → Dropout 0.1 → Conv 3×3 (init ×1e-5) → ⊕ skip (identity / 1×1 conv) → × 1/√2
emb = 512-d time vector (amber inset) → shift-only FiLM · ↓2×/↑2× fold a [1,1] box-filter resample into conv0 + skip · in0 additionally: → self-attn → × 1/√2
sampler: z_{i+1} = z_i + Δt · uθ(z_i, t_i, t_{i+1}, c) over 1–2 segments of [0,1] · R̂ = z₁ × σ_data (0.5) · X̂_t+1 = μ_t+1 + R̂ · NFE 1–2 (FlowCast 10, EDM 18–36)
Σ params — mapping 0.33 M · spatial_emb 2.36 M · encoder 26.71 M · decoder 51.64 M · total 81,040,772 · u(z_r, r, t) = 1/(t−r) ∫_r^t v(z_τ, τ) dτ · measured by instantiation at (192, 96)
